QuestInfo.name: Mushrooms Instead of Meat!
QuestInfo.0: You delivered the letter to #b#p1012003##k. Listen to his response.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Stan wishes the town had more meat, but will settle for some Mushrooms, which will have to do for now. Bring Chief Stan lots of Mushrooms.\n\r\n#i4000001# #t4000001# #b#c4000001# / 10#k
QuestInfo.2: After receiving the mushrooms, Chief Stan thanks you and tells you to feel free about asking him for anything. You really don't have anything to request of him at the moment, though.

0.0: Delayed delivery of the #t4032453#? We really need meat in Henesys, but I guess we'll just have to survive on mushrooms for a while... \r\n#b#L0#Is there anything I can help you with?#l\n#k
